summary: Global Ship Lease, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching its Second Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation, approved by shareholders at the June 17, 2026 annual meeting and filed with the Marshall Islands Registrar on July 14, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance event — an amendment and restatement of the charter — with no transaction, extraordinary corporate action, or financial terms disclosed. No advisor, recommendation, or deal mechanics are mentioned. This is not a special situation filing; it is a standard current report of a charter restatement.
